parole.significato: A flat, pan-like clay or metal griddle used to cook tortillas or other foods.
parole.testo: From Mexican Spanish comal, from Classical Nahuatl comālli.

parole.significato: The edible root of the yam bean (Pachyrhizus erosus) used in salads in Central America and as a snack in Mexico.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Mexican Spanish jícama, from Classical Nahuatl xīcama, apocopic form of xīcamatl.

parole.significato: Hominy; maize kernels which have undergone nixtamalization, that is, hulling and soaking and cooking in an alkaline sol…
parole.testo: From Mexican Spanish nixtamal, from Classical Nahuatl nextamalli (“hominy”), from nextli (“ashes, lime”) + tamalli (“something wrapped”).
